key_points: CEO Brian Moynihan guided Q3 investment banking fees down >10% YoY, triggering ~8% weekly stock decline.
BofA warned of potential Fed rate hikes missing 2% inflation target and scenarios of rates >5%, adding macro headwinds.
Higher yields are deepening accounting losses on bond holdings, threatening up to $90B.
Q2 2026 results showed strong $9.1B profit and 50% IB fee jump, providing some offsetting support.
Some analysts note stock trades below fair value after a 124% run, suggesting possible undervaluation.
